$comment: Hand-written metadata for component tokens (the fallback-only override surface). Everything else in the registry is generated from usage. `category` overrides the inferred value family; `stability` marks internal/deprecated exceptions; `component` overrides the prefix-derived grouping; `acceptedDivergence` names a reviewed reason for per-adapter fallback differences.

--ds-carousel-overlay-bg.purpose: The gradient scrim under a slide's caption.
--ds-carousel-overlay-bg.acceptedLiteral: A fixed black scrim: it sits on arbitrary imagery, not on a themed surface.

--ds-progress-circle-stroke.purpose: The ring thickness of the circular progress, in SVG user units.

--ds-aspect-ratio.purpose: The ratio the AspectRatio box keeps.

--ds-calendar-day-bg.acceptedLiteral: A day at rest paints nothing; the tint appears only on hover and selection.

--ds-card-actions-border.acceptedLiteral: The actions row divider is invisible until a variant turns it on.

--ds-carousel-overlay-text.acceptedLiteral: White on the fixed black scrim above; no themed surface is involved.

--ds-close-color.acceptedLiteral: Inherits the surrounding text colour on purpose.

--ds-code-block-copy-bg.acceptedLiteral: A translucent neutral overlay on the code surface; candidate for a dedicated overlay role after alpha.

--ds-code-block-copy-hover.acceptedLiteral: Same overlay one step stronger; same candidate role.

--ds-dialog-overlay.acceptedLiteral: The modal scrim: the darkest warm neutral at half alpha, deliberately theme-independent.

--ds-scroll-area-track.acceptedLiteral: The track paints nothing; only the thumb is visible.

--ds-skeleton-highlight.acceptedLiteral: The shimmer highlight is a translucent white sweep by design.

--ds-tree-bg.acceptedLiteral: The tree canvas paints nothing and inherits the page.
